FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|   |-- DisplayState: { rootIds, nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane> }
|   |   |-- Controller commands manage stored panes through display helpers.
|   |   `-- DisplayNodeBase extends DisplayGeometry
|   |       |-- position; bounds; coordinateSpace: 'canvas' | 'viewport'
|   |       |-- childIds; expansion; geometryPolicy; expandedGeometry?
|   |       `-- Collapse saves expanded allocation for later restoration.
|   `-- SelectionRegion captures panel context, not selection membership.
|       |-- kind: 'selection'; sourceBoxId; sourceContentId; sourceAscii; rect
|       `-- displayMode: 'stacked' | 'chained'; activeChildId?
|-- ConversationPane: thread, draft, presentation, canvasAnchor
|   `-- The bubble's semantic anchor is independent of panel presentation.
`-- Projection, detail and derived connections
    |-- ProjectedPane: title; projectionId?; sourceRevisionId?; targetRevisionId?
    |   `-- content.kind: 'call-tree' | 'compaction' | 'source-code' | 'code-panel'
    |       |-- Source panes retain file/projection metadata and saved scroll.
    |       `-- SourcePaneViewState manages live scrolling outside the display tree.
    |-- DetailPane: kind = 'detail'; title; ascii; sectionId?
    |-- Arrows are derived from document.edges and are absent from DisplayState.
    |-- FloatingPlacement: connection | grid-region | parent | conversation | stored
    `-- Display helpers return updated state values.
        |-- addDisplayNode(state, node, ownerId?)
        |   `-- Adds roots or parent links; the parent object alone is not a manager.
        |-- removeDisplayNode(state, id)
        |   `-- Removes descendants and repairs child and active-child references.
        |-- setExpansion(state, id, expansion)
        |-- updateDisplayGeometry(state, id, geometry); measureDisplayNode(...)
        `-- Measurement respects fixed expanded sizes and preserves no-op identity.
